name: print-social-listen-your-favorite-song-podcast-posts-peach-repeated-text
title: Podcast Instagram pack in peach with repeated 'Listen Your Favorite Song' background text and flat host illustrations
whatItIs: Nine peach square posts with a faint repeated 'Listen Your Favorite Song' background phrase, flat illustrations of a host wearing headphones at a mic and laptop, wavy line and star doodles, and headlines ('Make Your Own Podcast Channel On This Platform', 'Share Your Podcast on Social Media').
whatItMeans: Warm and personal; repeated background text mimics an audio waveform's rhythm even in a static image.
techniques: Repeat a phrase faintly as background texture across a set.
Illustrate the host as the recurring hero character.
Add small doodles (waves, stars) for a casual, handmade feel.

vocabulary.definition: A phrase tiled faintly behind the main content.
A recurring illustrated figure representing the brand.
